artifacts.raw_instruction: can you plan a trajectory to lift the small box and put it out

subgoals.description: Capture a new image of the scene to identify the small box.
Analyze the captured image to locate the 'small box' and obtain its 2D bounding box.
Estimate the 3D grasp pose, approach pose, and a potential place pose for the small box based on its 2D bounding box and class. The place_pose here is intended for placing it 'out'.
Move the robot gripper to an approach pose directly above the small box.
Provide real-time narration as the robot approaches the object.
Move the robot gripper down to the calculated grasp pose to make contact with the small box.
Activate the suction gripper to pick up the small box.
Lift the small box clear of the surface by moving back to the approach pose.
Provide real-time narration that the object has been grasped and is being lifted.
Move the robot with the small box to a safe transit pose before placing it 'out'. This is a placeholder for a specific 'out' transit location.
Provide real-time narration during the transport phase.
Move the robot to the designated 'out' place pose to release the small box.
Release the suction gripper to place the small box at the 'out' location.
Verify visually that the small box has been successfully lifted and placed 'out'.

assumptions: The 'small box' is clearly visible in the camera's field of view.
The robot is equipped with a suction gripper suitable for the small box.

A 'place_pose' is provided by 'estimate_grasp_pose' which represents a safe and valid 'out' location for the box. Alternatively, a safe 'transit_pose' and 'place_pose' for 'out' are accessible within the robot's workspace.
